mapper.select: SELECT #{month} AS month, COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN ai_audit_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aiProcessed, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manualIntervention, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status IN (1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closedCount FROM after_sale_order WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y%m') = #{month}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aiCompleted, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manualCompleted, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM after_sale_order WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y%m') = #{month} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT s.store_name AS storeName, COUNT(a.id) AS orderCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.ai_audit_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id) * 100, 1) AS aiProcessRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.ticket_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id) * 100, 1) AS rejectedRate FROM after_sale_order a JOIN store_info s ON a.store_id = s.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y%m') = #{month} GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY orderCount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected FROM after_sale_order WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label
